children.title: Define `skip`, `search`
children.payload:
const skip = query?.cursor ? 0 : (page - 1) * limit
const search = query?.search?.trim()

children.title: Define `years`
children.payload: const years = parseList(query?.years).map((y) => Number(y)).filter((y) => !isNaN(y))

children.title: Define `sortBy`, `sortOrder`
children.payload:
const sortBy = query?.sortBy ?? 'popularity'
const sortOrder = query?.sortOrder ?? sortBy === 'title' ? 'asc' : 'desc'
